caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica often means trading asphalt for ancient agricultural paths that follow the highest spine of the hills. Up here, on the routes mapped by My Adventure Costa Rica, the air is thin, cool, and smells of wet earth. There are no engines, no lane markings, and no easy gradients. The terrain asks for everything your legs can give, but it offers a rare silence in return. You stop not just to catch your breath, but to watch the mist reclaim the valley below. Send this to the one who would ride these ridges with you.
